mapper.update: UPDATE plt_collection_batch SET success_count = success_count + #{update.successDelta}, failure_count = failure_count + #{update.failureDelta}, status = CASE WHEN success_count + failure_count + #{update.successDelta} + #{update.failureDelta} = task_count THEN CASE WHEN failure_count + #{update.failureDelta} = 0 THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN success_count + #{update.successDelta} = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' END ELSE 'EXECUTING' END WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND id = #{update.batchId} AND deleted = b'0'
